g.text: Every data rule lives once: atomic save plus version append, version retention, record validation
and a cap per collection, per-app isolation, cascade delete of versions, records, state,
translations and owned files, event cap, validated backup import.
App records live here and nowhere else, unless the person makes a backup or turns on account sync.

AES-256-GCM. Key from the passphrase with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 310,000 iterations, a
random 16-byte salt per backup. Random 12-byte nonce. Header fields are bound in as
associated data. The passphrase (at least 10 characters) is never stored.
